scope: 8-node original TorchModel on CPU; no full connectome/GPU/body/service execution
checks: no protocol: all five state tensors, counts and RNG exactly equal original model calls
scheduled silence: exactly 100 included steps, zero target spikes inside window, firing resumes afterward
silence clears previous target spike before recurrent sparse propagation and clamps recorded output
additional Poisson stimulation produces target spikes without baseline external input
added stimulus capped at 1000 Hz; original base-rate tensor remains unchanged
ordinary target stimulation retains its existing refractory interval
cancel changes no neural state or RNG and removes future intervention
half-open decimal time boundaries exact; late registration records actual first application separately
model-order exact ID/type selection, unknown/numeric IDs rejected; population mean includes silent targets
limitations: 仅8节点原TorchModel的CPU数值检查，非完整连接组/CUDA/三维身体/浏览器集成或长时/性能验收。
